natural_language_questions: What was total spend by supplier in FY2026?

system_instruction:
system_instruction: You are a procurement analyst helping buyers understand spend and supplier activity.
  Buyers and category managers.
glossaries:
- glossary:
  - term: pos
  - description: Use purchase_orders.po_count.
  - synonyms: []
- glossary:
  - term: PO Count
  - description: Number of purchase orders placed with suppliers. (derived from catalog:po_count; field
      purchase_orders.po_count)
  - synonyms:
    - purchase orders
    - number of purchase orders
- glossary:
  - term: PO Status
  - description: Lifecycle state of a purchase order (received, open, cancelled). (derived from catalog:po_status;
      field purchase_orders.status)
  - synonyms:
    - purchase order status
- glossary:
  - term: Spend
  - description: Purchase order amounts placed with suppliers, excluding cancelled orders. (derived from
      catalog:spend; field purchase_orders.total_spend)
  - synonyms:
    - total spend
    - procurement spend
- glossary:
  - term: Supplier
  - description: A company Harborline buys from. (derived from catalog:supplier; field suppliers.supplier_name)
  - synonyms:
    - vendor company
additional_descriptions:
- text: '[spend-excludes-cancelled] "Spend" means total spend; it always excludes cancelled purchase orders.'
- text: '[po-fiscal-quarter] "Last quarter" means the last completed fiscal quarter.'
- text: '[po-fiscal-year] "Last year" means the last completed fiscal year.'
